query: INSERT INTO indexer_rolling_apy (indexer_address, rolling_apy_30d, rolling_apy_90d, computed_at) SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::float8[], $3::float8[]) AS t, LATERAL (SELECT NOW()) AS n(now) ON CONFLICT (indexer_address) DO UPDATE SET rolling_apy_30d = EXCLUDED.rolling_apy_30d, rolling_apy_90d = EXCLUDED.rolling_apy_90d, computed_at = NOW()
